blockers.description: Reopen evidence: Railway production, read 2026-10-05 via the Railway API: every service (api, ai-worker, events-worker, ingestion-worker, notifications-worker) has `OTEL_ENABLED=false` and no `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT`; `ws` has no OTel vars. `infra/terraform/environments/production/terraform.tfvars` keeps OTel off until `otel_exporter_endpoint` is set, and it is not set. Production exports no traces, metrics or logs.

Reopen evidence: KPI "99% of requests traced (actual: 99.0%)": production traces 0% of requests. `docs/shared/dashboard-catalog.md` documents dashboards. It does not show that any dashboard is live or connected to production.

To close: (1) Production OTel export on (IFC-032). A trace sample-rate measurement taken from the backend, plus at least one live dashboard URL. Closing requires production evidence (configured endpoint, real trace ID, received alert); local, in-memory or template artifacts do not count.
